def test_write_escalation_artifact_creates_file_and_content():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
        base = Path(tmpdir)
        path = write_escalation_artifact(
            task_id="task-123",
            contract_path="contracts/example.yaml",
            self_check_summary="PASS",
            verifier_summary="FAIL",
            disagreement_details="A passed, B failed on step 3",
            recommended_action="Review step 3 logic",
            base_dir=base,
        )
        assert path.exists()
        assert path.name == "escalation.yaml"
        # Check directory structure
        assert path.parent == base / "evidence" / "task-task-123"

        # Load and verify content
        with path.open() as f:
            data = yaml.safe_load(f)
        assert data["task_id"] == "task-123"
        assert data["contract_path"] == "contracts/example.yaml"
        assert data["self_check_result"] == "PASS"
        assert data["verifier_result"] == "FAIL"
        assert data["disagreement_summary"] == "A passed, B failed on step 3"
        assert data["recommended_action"] == "Review step 3 logic"
